explanation: High-speed nearly-horizontal impact into thin wall side overwhelms impulse plus positional correction: body arrives at ~31 m/s with dt~0.0236 (25 substeps), contacts wall side between steps 12-13, solver flips vx (bounce) but leaves centre 0.396 deep inside wall, exceeding 0.15 allowed overlap. Lowering impact speed removes failure, implicating inadequate substep/CCD handling for fast side collisions.
